# lean-pkg comparator migrate-signoff

move the deprecated inline judged_as / lean_pkg_scaffold keys of a configuration into lean-pkg-signoff.json; dry run unless --write (`comparator config --migrate-signoff PATH` is the same).

Also spelled: `lean-pkg comparator config --migrate-signoff PATH` ([all aliases](aliases.md)).

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg comparator migrate-signoff [--write] [--json] PATH
```

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `PATH` | the configuration; its Palomar keys are unchanged, its bytes (and so its receipt hash) change |
| `--write` | write both files |

## Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `comparator migrate-signoff PATH` | needs no registry: move the deprecated inline `judged_as` and `lean_pkg_scaffold` keys of the configuration `PATH` into `lean-pkg-signoff.json` at the package root (one `{reviewer, date, judged_as}` per definition hole, `config_sha256` bound to the migrated bytes; the scaffold block); dry run unless `--write` (prints both would-be files; `--write` writes the sidecar, then the configuration); refuses an inline sign-off that fails the rule, or a sidecar entry that conflicts; the Palomar keys and their values never change, but the file's bytes do, so a gated package needs a new comparator receipt: the output says so and prints the commands; see [The comparator tier](../comparator.md#migrating-from-inline-judged_as--lean_pkg_scaffold) | `[--write] [--json]` (`moved[]`, `dropped[]`, `config_sha256_before`, `config_sha256_after`, `receipt_impact`, `next_commands[]`, `written`) |

## JSON output

Top-level keys of `--json`, as recorded in the golden contract (tests/golden/json-keys.json):

- `comparator-migrate-signoff` (exit 0): `config`, `config_sha256_after`, `config_sha256_before`, `config_text`, `dropped`, `dry_run`, `moved`, `next_commands`, `ok`, `other_keys`, `palomar_keys_unchanged`, `receipt_impact`, `sidecar`, `signoff`, `written`

## Examples

Show how the deprecated inline judged_as keys would move into lean-pkg-signoff.json; --write writes both files.

```bash
lean-pkg comparator migrate-signoff comparator.json
```
